name: Kalasin Marathon 2026
short_description: Kalasin Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 4 October 2026 at Mueang Kalasin District Office in Kalasin, over 42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: Kalasin Marathon 2026, themed "Jurassic Isan", is the first edition of the Kalasin Marathon, according to the organiser. The start and finish are at Mueang Kalasin District Office, with a 42.195 km marathon, 21.1 km half marathon, 10 km mini marathon and 5 km fun run and family run. The marathon starts at 03:30 and the half marathon at 04:30.

faqs.question: What are the start times and cut-offs at Kalasin Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The marathon starts at 03:30 with a 7-hour cut-off, and the half marathon starts at 04:30 with a 4-hour cut-off. The 10 km starts at 05:30 (2 hours 30 minutes) and the 5 km fun run and family run at 05:45 (1 hour 30 minutes).

faqs.question: Where do runners collect race packs for Kalasin Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Race packs are collected on Saturday 3 October 2026, the day before the race. The organiser states that there is no on-site registration, and finisher shirts are given only to the 21.1 km and 42.195 km runners.
